description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1. Hello everyone. My friend and I are at odds. He has been an avid follower of Pastor Bohr, and concludes that the Mark of the Beast is going to be enforced Sunday REST. That obeying this mandate to not work, will qualify as " keeping the day holy". I totally disagree. I contend that there will be a component of forced actual WORSHIP. As in, attend a church on Sunday, and NO OTHER DAY Which one of us is correct, and how can this be clearly shown from the Bible and the Spirit of Prophecy?
.
2. To what extent "You shall not murder" can be taken? Am I sinning or offending God if I kill insects like mosquitoes and cockroaches or other animals that generally speaking are considered plagues? 
.
3. Hello Pastors, In Genesis 15:13, Acts 7:6, God tells Abraham that Israelites would spend 400 years in Egypt, but Exodus 12:40-41 shows that the Israelites stayed in Egypt for 430 years. Please explain the discrepancy. Thank you. Nelson, From Uganda.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org!
